title: HV_1_PBMC
extract_protocol_ch1: Skin biopsy from Degos disease patients and healthy volunteers were washed with PBS and digested enzymatically using whole skin dissociation kit (Miltenyi Biotec).  Following mechanical dissociation and filteration, cells were resuspended in 500 μL of complete RPMI-1640 with 10% FBS before sorting. Skin live cells were enriched by fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) using Sytox green. PBMCs from blood were isolated according to desity centrifugation method. PBMCs and CSF samples were subjected to ACK lysis treatment to remove RBCs. Finally, single cell suspensions prepared from skin, PBMCs and CSF were counted and and cell concentration was adjusted in the range of 700-1200 cells/ul with the viability of > 70% before being used for single-cell RNA-sequencing.
Library construction was performed in accordance with 10X Genomics protocol (10X Chromium 5' v2 or 5'-HT kit).
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v6.0.0 or v6.0.2
Assembly: GRCh38-2020-A

title: Degos_3_PBMC_PostRuxo_Wk_4_Rep2
extract_protocol_ch1: Skin biopsy from Degos disease patients and healthy volunteers were washed with PBS and digested enzymatically using whole skin dissociation kit (Miltenyi Biotec).  Following mechanical dissociation and filteration, cells were resuspended in 500 μL of complete RPMI-1640 with 10% FBS before sorting. Skin live cells were enriched by fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) using Sytox green. PBMCs from blood were isolated according to desity centrifugation method. PBMCs and CSF samples were subjected to ACK lysis treatment to remove RBCs. Finally, single cell suspensions prepared from skin, PBMCs and CSF were counted and and cell concentration was adjusted in the range of 700-1200 cells/ul with the viability of > 70% before being used for single-cell RNA-sequencing.
Library construction was performed in accordance with 10X Genomics protocol (10X Chromium 5' v2 or 5'-HT kit).
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v6.0.0 or v6.0.2
